description: Deterministic infrastructure fault injections. Each case must prove the named failure is contained or recovered without relying on an external model.

cases.test: deduplicates the same command and reuses one execution promise
cases.invariant: At-least-once delivery does not execute the same command twice.

cases.test: retains the high-water fence after a pre-start release
cases.invariant: A released or recovered old worker cannot reacquire an obsolete fence.

cases.test: rejects a JetStream event batch after its RunAttempt fence is superseded
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: A stale Worker cannot cross the transaction-scoped authority/Fence boundary into browser-visible JetStream events.

cases.test: replays one projected mutation ID as one PostgreSQL effect
setupTests: persists bounded branch context and durable operation records without a JSONL download
cases.invariant: At-least-once Session mutation delivery creates one canonical PostgreSQL effect.

cases.test: waits for older Session mutations before rechecking the new fence
cases.invariant: A replacement Worker crosses the Session-keyed projection barrier and rechecks its fence before reading PostgreSQL.

cases.test: commits a complete assistant message independently of public event delivery
cases.invariant: A streaming-path failure cannot roll back a complete Pi message already committed to SessionStorage.

cases.test: keeps a failed visible assistant prefix in the next native Pi context
cases.invariant: A browser-visible failed prefix remains model-visible after Worker replacement.

cases.test: settles a completed backend execution without consulting the live projection
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: A successful Run terminal commit does not reconstruct a complete message from the short-lived delta tail.

cases.test: accepts an already-ahead JetStream projection boundary during Run settlement
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: A JetStream event watermark already ahead of the Worker ACK cannot strand terminal Run settlement.

cases.test: keeps an active assignment alive while the Control Plane process is killed and replaced
cases.invariant: A Control Plane process replacement does not revoke a healthy fenced Agent Loop.

cases.test: defers channel retirement while a RunAttempt keeps heartbeating through PostgreSQL
cases.invariant: A stale Control Channel cannot retire a Worker whose active RunAttempt still has fresh database authority.

cases.test: settles a fenced active Run when the dead Worker has no management endpoint
cases.invariant: After connection and lease expiry, a dead management endpoint cannot strand the interrupted Run or Session.

cases.test: terminates expired and orphan runtimes before settling a lost assignment
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: Worker loss settles its model reservation so the replacement Run does not wait for quota TTL.

cases.test: resolves a Workspace through its Sandbox Domain without ambiguous columns
cases.invariant: A replacement writer can synchronously claim and retire the failed Run's fenced Tool activation.

cases.test: commits artifacts under a lease, cold-loads them, and rejects stale or corrupt state
cases.invariant: Checkpoint integrity and compare-and-swap fencing survive cold recovery.

cases.test: records cancellation as too late when natural completion wins before its ACK
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: Exactly one terminal Run outcome wins a cancel/complete race.

cases.test: fences a dispatcher whose pre-ACK claim lease was superseded
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: A superseded dispatcher cannot start external work.

cases.test: terminates expired and orphan runtimes before settling a lost assignment
setupTests: creates a project and workspace atomically, then creates a cold session
cases.invariant: Expired ownership is reconciled only after the orphan runtime is terminated.
